notes: Embedded World Cache Refresh: fixes the v1.1.0 seeded terrain appearing unchanged when the Home iframe retained pre-terrain Planet Lab assets across an in-place update. Agent City now sends no-store/no-cache headers for mutable local UI/world assets, bumps the v1.1 transition cache keys, refreshes the embedded Planet Lab onto a fresh build URL, and exposes explicit Local terrain status text for loading, loaded mesh, or flat fallback. The seeded terrain implementation itself is unchanged and all Simulation/discovery authority boundaries remain intact.
